title: 15 Cents James Buchanan US Postage Stamp 1938-1943 (Used) Rochester, NY
descriptionText: The product is a 15 cent United States postage stamp featuring historical figures from the years 1931-1940. Specifically, it depicts James Buchanan, a significant historical figure in American history. The stamp was used and originates from Rochester, New York, with a blue color. It is uncertified and ungraded, making it a unique and collectible piece for stamp enthusiasts and history buffs alike.
